QuestInfo.name: A Fifth Gift for the Dragon Master
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lv. 75, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: #p9010010#, in a sincere voice, congratulates you for reaching Lv. 75 and asks you to reach Lv. 80 to receive the final scroll. Go to town and meet with #p9010010# when you reach Lv. 80.
QuestInfo.2: You received a scroll from #p9010010#. #p9010010# says that she has given you everything she could and that all that is left is for you to work hard and believe in yourself.

0.0: Wow... You really did it, Evan. You really reached Level 75! Truth is, I didn't actually think you were going to do it... Luckily, I have one more scroll prepared for you anyway. When you reach Level 80, I will give you another really awesome scroll. Watching someone grow really warms my heart!

no.0: Hmm... You refuse? Please rethink your decision.

1.0: Although I've been encouraging you and cheering you on, I really didn't think you were going to do it this time. But you did it! Although I was mistaken about you, I don't feel bad at all.
1.1: This is the last scroll that I've prepared for you. I really didn't think I would be giving you this. Hehehe, you really are amazing!

yes.0: I've given you everything that I could. What's left is for you to do on your own. But I'm not worried. From what I've seen you do so far, I know that you will only get better and better!

default.0: Your Level is still a bit low. When you reach Level 80, you can receive a special gift that will only be given out during the event period. The event ends on May 4th, so be sure to hurry.
